shows.name: US comic claim sale, lettered grid A-J refilled through the show (Mint-Hunter Comics)
shows.note: Books (often full runs) sit in ten slots, top row A-E and bottom row F-J, and the host refills the grid throughout, announcing prices per slot ('20 bucks on C'); prices range roughly $8-$150. Viewers claim with 'claim <letter>'. The book in each slot changes, so items are slots, not titles. Some claims name a title or a whole row ('claim top row'); these cannot be placed on a slot. Whole-row claims earn a free book. No offers this week. priceCents is nominal.

shows.name: India handloom suits live, numbered suits, Hindi/Hinglish (Pure Handloom by Neeraj)

Suit 22 is never announced (host goes from 21 to 23) and is omitted. Price is 4590 + 100 shipping for most suits; 36 is 5290; 35 was sold without its bottom at 4590. Suit 20 had two pieces. From about 1:33 the host reconciles bookings and cancels (e.g. 'cancel kar do number seven'); current is null there.

shows.name: India jewellery live, pieces one at a time, Hindi/Hinglish (Preet Collection)
shows.note: Artificial jewellery (bangles, mangalsutra, necklace sets, jhumki, rings) shown one piece or tray at a time; the host says the price aloud (from about ₹150 to ₹6550) and viewers refer to pieces by price ('750 wale kangan', '1550 wala lena hain') or by what she is wearing. Booking is officially by WhatsApp, so much of chat is questions, complaints and 'like share done'. Item '1' stands for the piece on screen. Variants are the bangle sizes the host names (2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8) plus ONE-SIZE for unsized pieces. priceCents and qty are nominal.

shows.name: India saree & suit live, one at a time, Hindi/Haryanvi (Radhika Family)
shows.note: Sarees and suits shown one design at a time; claims are by colour ('red book kr dijiye', 'pink book', 'ye mera book kr do'). Prices vary by design (roughly ₹300-₹3650). Item '1' stands for the design on screen; variants are the colours the host names across the show. Stock per colour is not stated, so qty is nominal.
